Tide Watch

Early flood warnings for coastal streets.

Inspiration

Coastal neighborhoods often get less than an hour of warning before streets flood. We wanted residents to know about rising water before it reaches their doorstep, without relying on expensive municipal gauges.

What it does

Tide Watch reads ultrasonic water level sensors mounted under storm drains and pushes a text message to subscribed residents when the reading climbs past a threshold that the neighborhood association sets on a shared dashboard.

The prototype ran for two weeks on one street.
